command:
set -euo pipefail
expected=2f9fa1004ab140eb312302f799bf2e6165c4aff6
[[ "$(hostname)" == andreas-MACO && "$(id -un)" == andreas ]] || exit 91
[[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" == "$expected" ]] || { echo HEAD_MISMATCH >&2; exit 92; }
state=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)
[[ "$state" == inactive || "$state" == failed ]] || { echo "VM_NOT_INACTIVE state=$state" >&2; exit 93; }
[[ -z "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ExecStopPost --value)" ]] || { echo EXECSTOPPOST_NOT_EMPTY >&2; exit 94; }
echo "PRE_STAGE state=$state head=$expected"
sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py stage --execute
sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py verify
condition_rc=0
sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py condition || condition_rc=$?
[[ "$condition_rc" -eq 0 ]] || { echo "CONDITION_NOT_GREEN rc=$condition_rc" >&2; exit 95; }
manifest=/var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json
sudo -n test -f "$manifest" || { echo CUTOVER_MANIFEST_MISSING >&2; exit 96; }
echo "MANIFEST_SHA=$(sudo -n sha256sum "$manifest" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo 'DURABLE_STATE_BEGIN'
sudo -n find /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state -maxdepth 5 -type f -printf '%P %s bytes\n' | sort
echo 'DURABLE_STATE_END'
echo 'BINDS_BEGIN'
sudo -n grep '^ENTITYOS_IDENTITY_BINDS=' /etc/entityos/entityos.conf
echo 'BINDS_END'
post=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)
[[ "$post" == inactive || "$post" == failed ]] || { echo "UNEXPECTED_START state=$post" >&2; exit 97; }
echo "POST_STAGE state=$post CUTOVER_VERIFY=PASS CONDITION=PASS NO_START=1"
